metadata.title: Dang Trung Kien — Front-end Developer
metadata.description: Portfolio of Dang Trung Kien, a Front-end Developer with 2.5+ years of experience.

hero.summary: Front-end Developer with 2.5+ years of experience building responsive web applications. I work with React.js and related technologies, focusing on user-centered design, clean code, and reliable functionality.

about.description: I am a Front-end Developer with experience building responsive web applications and interactive user interfaces. I collaborate with backend teams to integrate APIs, refine requirements into practical solutions, and improve performance and code quality.

skills.description: Technologies and tools used across my frontend work.

frontend.title: Frontend development
frontend.proof: Build responsive web applications and interactive interfaces with attention to cross-browser compatibility.

frameworks.title: Frameworks & libraries
frameworks.proof: Experience with ReactJS and related frameworks and libraries, including Gatsby, Next.js, Angular, and Vue.js.

api-cms.title: API & CMS
api-cms.proof: Integrate RESTful APIs and GraphQL, and contribute to CMS projects built with WordPress and Gatsby.

tools.title: Tools & collaboration
tools.proof: Work with Git and Agile/Scrum practices, using Jira and Trello for project coordination.

experience.description: More than 2.5 years of frontend development experience at AHT JSC.

highlights: Analyzed requirements, designed solutions, and built modern, interactive interfaces with responsive and cross-browser support.
Collaborated with backend teams to integrate RESTful APIs and GraphQL.
Optimized code and performance across e-commerce and management projects.
Maintained websites and apps, fixed bugs, and developed new features.
